_comment: Seed queries for harvesting the GoHighLevel operation catalogue from the LeadConnector MCP.
WHY SEEDS AND NOT AN ENUMERATION.
The MCP facade exposes `search_operations`, which is a SEMANTIC search, not a list API. There is
domains:['opportunities'], limit:100})` returns 0 results, because the query text still drives
relevance and the domain is only a filter layered on top. A generic query matches nothing.
So the catalogue is harvested by issuing many targeted queries and unioning the results by
operationId. That means coverage is a FLOOR, never a proven total — the same rule this codebase
applies to any capped scan. Add seeds to raise the floor; never claim the catalogue is complete.
Collection needs MCP access, so it is run by an agent, not by a script: for each seed below call
`search_operations({query, domains, limit: 100})`, union the results by operationId, and write
them to operations.json. Then `node scripts/catalogue-gap.mjs` does the analysis offline.
The split is deliberate — the expensive, credential-bound step happens once; the diff that
actually produces decisions runs forever without a network or a token.
